The '''Tadra sector''' was a remote [[Sector/Legends|sector]] near the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] and the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vo Tunbren]]. It was a subsector of the [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]].
